overview: From 2025-10-26 to 2025-11-02, Sendo-labs/plugin-sendo-analyser had 8 new PRs (7 merged), 0 new issues, and 2 active contributors.

topPRs.title: Feat: migrate to plugin-sendo-analyser implementation
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
Migrates complete sendo-api functionality into ElizaOS plugin:
- 7 REST API endpoints: /signatures, /trades, /transactions, /tokens, /nfts, /global, /wallet
- SendoAnalyserService with wallet analysis methods
- Multi-protocol transaction decoders (Jupiter, Raydium, Pump.fun, Orca, Meteora, Whirlpool)
- Helius SDK and BirdEye API integration
- Drizzle ORM schemas for caching (wallet_analysis_cache, wallet_insights) - Not used
- TypeScript types and Zod schemas for data validation

topContributors.summary: standujar: This week, standujar drove the creation and integration of a new service, `plugin-sendo-analyser`, through a massive initial migration (plugin-sendo-analyser#1, +17774 lines). They followed this with numerous enhancements to the new plugin, including updating dependencies, adding comprehensive documentation, and integrating the latest API updates (plugin-sendo-analyser#3, #4, #6). Further work included refactoring the `plugin-sendo-worker` to use an official API (plugin-sendo-worker#4), demonstrating a primary focus on new feature development and system modernization.

Neysixx: Drove significant development on the frontend, merging seven pull requests focused on both new features and large-scale refactoring. They implemented key capabilities including a chat agent (#13), agent creation (#11), and Privy integration (#10), while also executing a substantial refactor of the agent environment in a large PR (#15) that changed over 5,700 lines of code. This activity shows a primary focus on refactoring and feature work related to the application's agent and worker systems.

xdrkush: Focused on significant feature work and API enhancements, merging five pull requests across the Sendo-labs repositories. They delivered a major new 'merge-analyzer' feature in the frontend (Sendo-labs/frontend#17) and improved the backend API's data analysis and rate limiting (Sendo-labs/sendo-api#6). This work, combined with several smaller API refactors, showed a primary focus on bugfixes and improving the overall codebase.

plvo: Focused on documentation this week, opening a pull request in Sendo-labs/Reports (#2) related to Python actions testing. This contribution added 245 lines of new content, with all work concentrated in documentation.

M4XGO: Focused on establishing an automated release process this week by opening a pull request to add new release configurations and workflows (Sendo-labs/plugin-sendo-analyser#8). This work involved adding 132 lines of new code across 8 files. Their contributions were entirely focused on configuration files to support this new feature.

Fleo-Thyphon-ElizaOS: Focused on improving the project's testing infrastructure this week, pushing a substantial commit that modified 12 files (+1527/-617 lines). They also provided feedback on a pull request. This activity indicates a primary focus on tests.
